{{Top|leg}}
'''Transport Maintenance''' was a division of the [[Republic Defense Procurement Office/Legends|Republic Defense Procurement office]].<ref name="tz">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>

One of their personnel was operating as a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], whom [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Mereel Skirata]] promptly [[Death/Legends|assassinated]] by slicing into the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] platform controls.<ref name="tz" />
